    - img "EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites"
- heading "Data Processing Systems Engineer" [level=2]
- heading "EUMETSAT - European Organisation for the Exploitation of Meteorological Satellites" [level=2]
- heading "Darmstadt, Germany" [level=2]
- paragraph: EUMETSAT is Europe’s meteorological satellite agency - monitoring the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- paragraph: Within the Data Processing Systems Engineering Competence Area (DP S&A) of the Satellite System Ground Segments Division (SGS) Division, the Data Processing Systems Engineers support the design, development/upgrade, verification and validation of Data Processing systems including the associated procurements and support their maintenance and evolutions during the operations phase. For the first years, the post holder is expected to primarily contribute to the transition of the new missions from development to operations.
- paragraph: You will work in an environment led by innovation and excellence. Joining EUMETSAT will give an unpaired opportunity to develop your professional path in satellite data processing.
- paragraph: We are seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented person to join our dynamic team as a key player in driving our organization’s growth and success. If you are a collaborative team player with a proven track record of driving results and are looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply for this exciting role.
- heading "What you’ll be doing" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Define and maintain requirements and specifications in support to the development of new Data Processing systems or for upgrades to existing systems;
  - listitem: Contribute and follow-up the related developments/procurements and their integration into full scale Data Processing Systems and/or Ground Segments;
  - listitem: Contribute to the definition of, execution and follow up of Integration and Verification & Validation (IV&V) testing of new or evolved Data Processing Systems and Applications;
  - listitem: Support the scheduling and prioritisation of tasks, and the assessment of the adequacy of deliverables from other teams, organisations or industrial suppliers;
  - listitem: Contribute to the definition, planning and execution of the transition and handover of Data Processing Systems from the development phase to routine maintenance and operations;
  - listitem: Support the Data Processing Systems and Applications Competence Area Manager in defining long term plans and roadmaps to harmonise engineering, maintenance and evolutions of Data Processing Systems across all satellite systems exploited by EUMETSAT.
- heading "What we offer" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem:
    - text: Excellent salary, of up to Euro 8,500
    - strong: NET (after tax)
    - text: based on skills and experience;
  - listitem: Flexible working time including additional flexi-leave;
  - listitem: Full medical coverage for employee and family;
  - listitem: Attractive pension;
  - listitem: 30 days of annual leave + 14.5 days public holidays;
  - listitem: Training and development support;
  - listitem: Relocation allowance and support (if applicable).
- heading "Requirements" [level=3]
- heading "Qualifications:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: A university degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software or Systems Engineering or another relevant discipline.
- heading "Skills and Experience:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Proven experience in engineering of Data Processing systems following well established processes, covering the full development lifecycle and relevant technical standards (e.g. ECSS, CCSDS, OGC);
  - listitem: Demonstrable knowledge of software development lifecycles and change control processes;
  - listitem: Competence in the area of Data Processing Systems Integration, Verification &Validation (IV&V) activities, including automated testing, software testing, unit test suite maintenance, software debugging and profiling;
  - listitem: Ability to manage complex tasks with minimum supervision, including planning and prioritisation of activities, allocation and coordination of resources, monitoring and reporting;
  - listitem: Good interpersonal and communication skills with proven ability to apply these to a team environment while working within a matrix structure;
  - listitem: Experience leading/coordinating engineering teams and in the management of industrial contracts in relevant area will be considered an advantage.
- paragraph:
  - strong: APPLICATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH
  - text: . WE WILL BE UNABLE TO CONSIDER APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED IN OTHER LANGUAGES.
- paragraph: EUMETSAT is an international organisation employing staff from across all 30 member states and this role is being advertised on multiple international job boards, but please note that this role would be based in Darmstadt, Germany and would require international applicants to relocate if successful. Remote working is not an option for this role.
- heading "More about us" [level=3]
- paragraph:
  - strong: EUMETSAT’s role is to establish and operate meteorological satellites to monitor the weather and climate from space - 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. This information is supplied to the National Meteorological Services of the organisation's Member and Cooperating States in Europe, as well as other users worldwide.
- paragraph:
  - strong: EUMETSAT also operates several Copernicus missions on behalf of the European Union and provide data services to the Copernicus marine and atmospheric services and their users.
- paragraph:
  - strong: As an intergovernmental European Organisation, EUMETSAT can recruit nationals only from the 30 Member States (Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey and the United Kingdom).
- paragraph

- text: Don't forget to mention EuroTechJobs when applying.
